comments: PROVENANCE: this approval was given verbally by Anil in an agent chat session on 2026-09-05 and transcribed into this artifact by sdd-workflow-orchestrator at his explicit and repeated direction. It is a genuine owner decision, but it is weaker evidence than an approval authored by the reviewer, and it is recorded as such here rather than being presented as a document the reviewer wrote. CLR-TP-ETA-411-001 (that no acceptance criterion in scope is API-verifiable this release) and CLR-TP-ETA-411-002 (that TS-ETA-411-007 asserts the presence of an error message rather than its wording) were NOT answered individually. Approving the plan carries both by default, per section 4 of the review package. If either default is not what was intended, this approval should be superseded by a new version rather than reinterpreted.

itemDecisions.comment: The six named modules are offered. Presence only; openability is carried by TS-002, TS-003 and TS-005. UI.
The three Dashboard icons each open their module. UI.
The three navigation menu entries each open their module. Kept separate from TS-002 because both entry points exist for the same two modules. UI.
Preferences is offered with Organization and Vault beneath it. Presence only, per the Gate 1 answer that Preferences is a grouping rather than a destination. UI.
Organization and Vault open their own pages. Arrival asserted on page content because Organization shares a destination with the Preferences icon. UI.
Command Center returns to Home from each module. Will need a VALIDATED locator waiver at Gate 3; the control has no accessible name. UI.
An unauthenticated visitor is refused and kept on the sign-in page. No credential is entered, so no lockout risk. Message wording not asserted. UI.
